places.getThere: Fly to Phu Bai (HUI, ~15 km from the centre) or take the train to Hue Station. From Da Nang/Hoi An it is ~2–2.5 h by road via the Hai Van tunnel.

days.title: 顺化皇城
days.morning: Bún bò Huế for breakfast, then the Imperial City – Ngo Mon Gate – Forbidden Purple City.
days.afternoon: Thien Mu Pagoda and Minh Mang Tomb.
days.evening: Listen to Hue folk songs on a dragon boat and release lanterns on the Perfume River.

days.title: 皇陵与美食
days.morning: Khai Dinh Tomb and Tu Duc Tomb.
days.afternoon: Thuy Xuan incense village and Dong Ba market.
days.evening: Food tour of bánh bèo, bánh nậm and Hue sweet soups on Han Thuyen street.

days.title: 三江潟湖 – 顺安海滩
days.morning: Chuon lagoon on Tam Giang, with lagoon seafood.
days.afternoon: Phuoc Tich ancient village and Thuan An beach.

days.title: 白马山 – 朗姑
days.morning: Bach Ma National Park and Do Quyen waterfall.
days.afternoon: Lang Co bay – one of the world's most beautiful bays.

days.title: 翻越海云岭到岘港
days.morning: Ride the Hai Van pass and stop at Hai Van Gate.
days.afternoon: Swim at My Khe and visit Linh Ung Pagoda on Son Tra.
days.evening: See the Dragon Bridge lit up in Da Nang.
